<function name="GetFloat" parent="IMaterial" type="classfunc">

	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="materialFloat" type="string">The name of the material value.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">float</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
